records.title: Current Activities in Aerophysiological Training and Future Perspectives. Italian Air Force
records.locator: Printed pp. 75 and 78, adverse-effects paragraph and reference 4
records.evidence_note: The chapter reports 0.1% DCS in a review of 1,777 military flight crew and paratrooper trainees. An exact event count, role-specific denominators, ascertainment period and repeat-person linkage are unavailable. The chapter cites the 2010 military medicine report about the earlier Italian Air Force training cohort. The 1,777 trainees may include records from the 2003–2009 analysis of 1,241 evaluable trainees. Dates for the 1,777 and participant-level linkage are unavailable, so the rounded rate remains on overlap hold.

records.title: Oxidative stress response to simulated altitude training: a longitudinal study of the biomarker variation and the contributing factors
records.locator: Methods and Results, printed p. 2, and Table 1, p. 4
records.extraction_method: Publisher HTML verified with indexed PDF text
records.evidence_note: A urinary biomarker study of 47 participants, including 37 trainees and 10 inside observers, in five chamber sessions. No clinical DCS ascertainment, measured VGE or individual data are reported publicly. The study reports biomarker sampling 30 and 120 minutes after training.
